title: Miantuan Pets
mastheadTitle: A public gallery for imaginary friends, their guardians, and visiting guests.
mastheadIntro: Miantuan Pets collects remembered companions, dream friends, friendly guardians, and soft spirits as installable Codex pets. Companions from other worlds are welcome to visit, too.
podTitle: Shape the companion before it becomes a pet.
podBody: Start in Miantuan Pod when you want to remember, describe, or refine an imaginary friend before preparing a public pet entry.
galleryIntro: Each entry lists its owner and reference source separately, alongside sharing credit and install files.
